lines.zh: 我从地里拱出来，往前挪。
lines.en: I push up out of the earth and crawl on.

lines.zh: 土块从我的脊背上滚落。
lines.en: Clods roll off my back.

lines.zh: 我拖着身体，草地被犁开。
lines.en: I drag myself, ploughing the grass.

lines.zh: 我的头在土里钻，尾在后。
lines.en: Head through soil, tail behind.

lines.zh: 我绕过那块石头，绕得很慢。
lines.en: I go around the boulder. Slowly.
I smell something living on the ground.

lines.zh: 身下的泥土一阵阵震动。
lines.en: The earth shivers under me.
I writhe toward the noise.

lines.zh: 我身形很宽，路都被占了。
lines.en: I am wide. I take up the path.
Earth clings to my plates.
I coil, and the soil shifts.
I listen to echoes under the ground.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看上去更长。
lines.en: I am longer than I look.
The worms have all fled.
I wait for a tremor.
I open my jaws; soil falls in.
My plates rasp the grass roots.

lines.zh: 这一带的地面被我翻过。
lines.en: I have turned this ground already.

lines.zh: 我吸了一口气，土都动了。
lines.en: I inhale and the dust moves.

lines.zh: 腐土下面的卵，一窝挨着一窝。
lines.en: The eggs under the rot-soil lie nest upon nest.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进土里，又抬起来。
lines.en: I bury my head, then lift it.
I have flattened the topsoil.
I coil a little tighter.
The quiet irritates me.
Eggs cluster beneath me.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了整片草地。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole clearing.
You stepped onto my ground.

lines.zh: 这具身体比你的房子宽。
lines.en: This body is wider than your house.
They call me the Eater of Worlds.
You smell of rot.
I raise my head and soil falls.

lines.zh: 你的武器，先看看够不够长。
lines.en: Is that weapon long enough?
I have dug down here for years.
Step back. I keep coming.

lines.zh: 我的身体一节节从土里拱起。
lines.en: My body arches out of the soil segment by segment.
Do not step on the eggs.

lines.zh: 你脚下的腐土，全是我的道。
lines.en: The rot-soil under you is all my tunnel.

lines.zh: 我很少上来，你运气不好。
lines.en: I rarely surface. Bad luck.
A plate falls off me.
I sink, then rise again.
My blood darkens the soil.

lines.zh: 断掉的那截身子在土里扭。
lines.en: My severed segment writhes in the soil.

lines.zh: 这一下，我从土里翻出来。
lines.en: That drives me up out of the soil.
I do not cry out. I tremble.

lines.zh: 我身体断了一截，还会长。
lines.en: A segment breaks. It regrows.
That struck deep.
I lower my head and burrow again.
The ground took half of it.
Food? I eat the ground.

lines.zh: 你把肉举起来，我看不见。
lines.en: I cannot see what you raise.
Put it down and move.

lines.zh: 你把土挖开，我就有兴趣了。
lines.en: Open the soil and I take an interest.

lines.zh: 地上的一切最后都是我的。
lines.en: All on this ground ends as mine.

lines.zh: 你把土挖开，我就会有兴趣。
lines.en: Dig up the soil and I may care.

lines.zh: 那块腐肉，倒是有点味道。
lines.en: That carrion has some smell.
Hold it longer and your arm tires.
That will not fill a tooth.
Put it away. I want the earth.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的鳞上，退开了。
lines.en: You hit my plates and fall back.
I turn and shove the soil aside.
I am heavier than stone.
You stand beside me. Very small.
Do not press close. You would be drawn in.
The bump throws up earth.
I shift aside, leaving a hollow.
You are pushed back three steps.

lines.zh: 我盘身时，尾巴扫过你的膝。
lines.en: My tail crosses your knees as I coil.

lines.zh: 你碰在我鳞上，像碰树根。
lines.en: You touch my plates like roots.

lines.zh: 我身下这些卵，不需要伴侣。
lines.en: These eggs need no partner.

lines.zh: 我们是从腐土里长出来的。
lines.en: We grow from rotting soil.

lines.zh: 世界要被吃掉，不是要延续。
lines.en: The world is to be eaten, not continued.
Your question is shallow.
I only need to finish this layer.

lines.zh: 别问了，土会记住你的声音。
lines.en: Stop. The soil remembers your voice.
The eggs hatch on their own.

lines.zh: 我从土里拱出来，土块滚落。
lines.en: I push up out of the earth, clods rolling off.
Worry about your footing.
Leave. I am going under.
I swallow this lump of earth.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，埋进土里了。
lines.en: What you dropped is buried.

lines.zh: 我用身体把它压进地里。
lines.en: I press it into the ground.
I shift the eggs aside.
That stone is too hard. I go around.
I curl the carrion into my jaws.

lines.zh: 我的嘴太大，拿不住小的。
lines.en: My jaws are too big for small things.
It fell into a hole I dug.

lines.zh: 地面会替我把东西收好。
lines.en: The ground stores it for me.
Take it. I do not care.
The ground begins to shake.
I raise my head your way.
You stand at the edge of my pit.

lines.zh: 你落脚的那块地，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the patch you stand on.
Clods fall from above.
This bite begins underground.
I burrow your way.
Your house will not stop me.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片刮过树根，沙沙响。
lines.en: My scales scrape the roots with a rasp.
I begin to push forward.
Hear the earth give way?
My head is aimed at you.
Retreat and the ground retreats too.
The world is shrinking.
Now I swallow.
The soil gives by your feet.
I am under your feet.
You cannot dodge this.
The earth pushes me to you.

lines.zh: 你脚下的地面整个裂开了。
lines.en: The ground under you splits wide.

lines.zh: 我在你脚下慢慢穿过去。
lines.en: I pass slowly beneath you.
Soil splits at your boots.

lines.zh: 我的身体在下面盘起来。
lines.en: I coil below.
You should not stand on this ground.

lines.zh: 我的头慢慢从土里冒出来。
lines.en: My head rises from the soil.
The shaking grows nearer.
Onto the stone. Wise.
I ring you, layer by layer.
Hear the earth moving?
I know this tunnel.
There is nothing under you now.
A moment more and I am there.
My body blocks the way.
A step back, a collapse.
I need not look. The earth tells me.
Cracks are already at your side.
I count your footfalls.
I turn this ground.
You are panicking. Good.
Last ring. I tighten.
I burst up from below.
My jaws close on your leg.
I coil and pin you.
Earth and blood mix.
That blow opens the ground.
You rise, then land hard.
My body sweeps your knees.
The ground shakes with it.
You retreat; the soil follows.
Your armor rings in my jaws.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬起头，你还站着。
lines.en: I lift my head. You remain standing.

lines.zh: 我啃掉你脚边一整块草皮。
lines.en: I tear away a whole patch of turf by your feet.
Half of me is still below.
I sink. Do not follow.
The ground begins to bulge.
A crack opens in the turf.
Clods roll away and I emerge.
A deep tremor.
This ground has gone loose.
My head breaks the surface first.
The thing below has woken.
Everything goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我盘着身子，占了整片空地。
lines.en: I coil and fill the clearing.
Grass presses into mud.
I rise out of rotting soil.
The ground splits into pieces.
Grit settles over me.
The earth is restless tonight.
I coil slowly and watch you.
All under the soil is me.
The noise starts under your feet.

lines.zh: 腐土被我翻成一座新丘。
lines.en: I turn the rot-soil into a fresh mound.

lines.zh: 土地下的黑暗，比夜更深。
lines.en: The dark beneath the land is deeper than night.
The world has one more hole.
Fire scorches my plates.

lines.zh: 我从洞里滚下去，压塌了壁。
lines.en: I roll down the tunnel and crush it.

lines.zh: 水灌进洞里，我沉得更快。
lines.en: Water fills the burrow. I sink faster.
The blast lifts the whole field.
An arrow sinks between plates.

lines.zh: 一节一节的身子，卡住了。
lines.en: Segment by segment, I lock up.
No earth to swallow and I thin.
Lightning blackens the ground.

lines.zh: 我穿破了地层，下面是空。
lines.en: I break through the strata into nothing.
